body.statement: On every sufficiently large revealed graph satisfying \(\|B_GP_n\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le Ld_n^{7/4}\), the log-tuned seed law and \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}\) are observed-data measurable, unbiased for \(\tau_{\mathrm{GATE}}(y)\), and obey \[\sup_{y\in\mathcal M(G,\tau_{\mathrm{GATE}},2)}\mathbb E\!\left[\{\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}-\tau_{\mathrm{GATE}}(y)\}^2\mid G\right]\le C\,r_{\log}(n,d_n)\] for a universal \(C<\infty\).
body.justification: This synthesis certifies that the inherited observed-data seed construction attains the lower-bound scale once the new dense four-root estimate and the separate sparse certificate are available.
body.gap: The published Kandiros--Harshaw--S\'{a}vje upper edge is of order \(d_n^2/n\), and the archived seed analysis reaches no smaller order without the missing Boolean covariance certificate; the strict advance is the matched upper edge on that same game.
body.consumer: Theorem 4 supplies KarrerEtAl2021Scale with a degree-sensitive precision benchmark and a concrete alternative to fixed clustering.
